personality_one_liner: A cinematic and premium e-commerce experience with deep midnight surfaces, rich gold accents, and frosted glass depth that puts high-end functionality first.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing. Cinematic feel. Empty space is content on purpose.

do's: Sticky payment ribbon at bottom of checkout
Floating panels and premium status surfaces

screens.name: Checkout Flow
screens.purpose: A unified single-screen checkout with dynamic shipping discovery and an elegant bottom-anchored payment ribbon.

states.loading: Centered premium gold spinner on midnight background.
states.error: Readable ruby-tinted message with a retry button.

screens.layout: Stacked card layout with generous spacing. Sections: 1. Location Map (العنوان على الخريطة), 2. Delivery Mode (طريقة التوصيل - Auto-decided based on map radius), 3. Shipping Carrier Selection (شركات الشحن - logo, name, ETA, cost), 4. Warranty Summary (الضمان), 5. Payment Selection (طرق الدفع - BNPL previews included), 6. Loyalty Points Slider (استبدال النقاط). Crucial: A fixed bottom glass ribbon over scrolling content that contains 'Confirm' button, Total, and horizontal scroll of supported payment mini-logos.

screens.name: Merchant Payment Settings (Admin)
screens.purpose: Allows merchants to configure and input credentials for multiple payment gateways.
screens.layout: List of available providers (Mada, Apple Pay, STC Pay, Tabby, Tamara, etc.). Each row has an enable/disable switch. Tapping a row opens a bottom sheet or modal for entering credentials (API keys, secret keys). Display 'معتمد قانونياً في المملكة' SAMA badge for approved gateways. Include Bulk Enable preset chips at the top.

screens.name: Merchant Shipping Settings (Admin)
screens.purpose: Allows merchants to toggle Saudi shipping carriers and enter API keys.
screens.layout: List of carriers (SMSA, SPL, Aramex, etc.) with switches. Tapping reveals a credential modal. Fields include base price, per-kg price, COD support toggle. Map delivery radius configuration is included at the top.

screens.name: Loyalty & Rewards Hub
screens.purpose: Showcases the user's loyalty tier, point balance, and redeemable rewards.

states.empty: Illustration of empty wallet with 'ابدأ التسوق لجمع النقاط' (Start shopping to collect points)

screens.layout: Hero section with a dark abstract gold background and frosted glass overlay displaying 'رصيد نقاط الولاء: X نقطة' and a progress bar to the next tier (Bronze/Silver/Gold/Platinum). Below, a grid of rewards (Rewards Shop) and recent transaction history.

instructions_to_main_agent: Design heavily around the Glass / Luxe DARK personality. No blue colors anywhere. Default primary accents are Zenrex Gold.

Implement a highly prominent, elegant glassmorphic sticky ribbon anchored at the bottom of the checkout flow containing the total amount, the primary 'Confirm' CTA, and horizontally scrolling mini-logos of the supported Saudi payment providers.

The checkout screen MUST be a unified single-page scroll layout containing Location, Delivery, Shipping Options, Warranty, Payment, and Loyalty sliders, strictly following progressive disclosure patterns.
Implement the map-based auto-detection logic: compare user's location radius to the branch delivery zone. If outside, auto-show the Shipping Carriers component. Hide local delivery.
In Admin screens, implement bottom sheet modals for entering exact credentials per provider. Display an official SAMA badge ('معتمد قانونياً في المملكة') on Mada and licensed BNPL (Tabby/Tamara).
Loyalty tier progress, point redemption sliders, and dynamic BNPL text (e.g., '4 دفعات بقيمة 125 ر.س') must be fully baked into the checkout schema.
Use Arabic texts as requested for primary labels and English for system structures.
